findings.title: China's EV makers shift gears to focus on humanoids as car market slows - CNBC
findings.reason: The article reports that China's EV sales are headed for their worst year since 2021 amid slowing growth and intense competition, with the vehicle manufacturing sector's average profit margin falling to just 1.5% in the first half of 2026. Major players like Xpeng and BYD have seen shares tumble over 45% and 13% respectively, undercutting the claim of strong sector performance in 2026.
